name: Holi
description: Historians can't seem to agree on the origins of this holiday. Shiva, Kama, Krishna, Vishnu... But what really matters is that this holiday brings people joy... and paints.
interestingFacts: The paint was available for purchase in a set of "Holi" for $59.99. from 12 to March 26, 2019.
The paint was issued as the Holiday paint for the day of the dead celebrations on November 4th, 2021.

This paint became claimable again by participating in the "eSports {GAME} Fund 2026" event and the player with the highest number of Booster purchases at the end of the event will secure the top spot and earn the paint!
